positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
- Implement new dashboard features within App Academy's website to improve tracking of future bootcamp students. 

- Contribute instructional guidance and curriculum improvements to App Academy's Jumpstart Program.

positions.title: Staff Accountant
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
Novacoast is an experienced and comprehensive IT business resource with many specialities ranging from implementation services to creating custom personalized solutions for clients.


Responsibilities:

 - Perform monthly research, analysis, and reconciliation of major general ledger accounts such as Unearned Revenue, Revenue/COGs, and Fixed Assets.

 - Responsible for accurate and timely processing of daily cash receipts, as well as preparation of daily cash report sent to CFO, COO and accounting department. 

 - Carry out monthly Borrowing Base Certificates schedules, Accounts Receivable Roll Forward entries, and generate AR/AP Aging reports for review and budget forecast analysis.

 - Research problems and special cases arising with Novacoast billing by working closely with sales and clients to reach a mutual understanding and resolution.

 - Ensure a healthy cash flow for Novacoast with management of generating and reviewing AR Aging reports, as well as collection calls.

 - Accountable for preparing, analyzing, and filing monthly Sales and Use tax returns for Novacoast in 25+ states.

 - Generation of quarterly/yearly revenue and client breakdown analysis reports for company leadership and sales.

 - Experience with assisting external audits through providing reports and fulfilling information requests.

 - Initiate wires and ACHs to vendors, employees, and payroll when necessary.


Achievements:

Hero of the Month: October 2014
For assisting with the painless transition of departmental personal changes, as well as the ability to take on an increased and more comprehensive workload when requested.

Most Valuable Corporate Employee: 2014
Nominated by Gabe Laughlin, CFO of Novacoast.
